batch_selection: Two smallest saved batches with at least four candidates; only the first pair fit the bounded allowance.
deployment_decision: Keep factoring opt-in and disabled for the new campaign.
limitations: One development batch and one execution per arm; not a held-out scientific evaluation.
Arm order was not counterbalanced because the second pair was budget-deferred.
Partner evidence bases and constraint severity/basis differ despite matching candidate decisions; scientific noninferiority is not established.
